Diagnosis.submission: The recommendation Service in the astronomy-shop namespace had internalTrafficPolicy set to Local instead of the default Cluster. Because there is a single recommendation pod running on node kind-worker, the ClusterIP (10.96.41.79:8080) only accepted traffic from endpoints on that same node. Calls from pods on other nodes (e.g., the frontend on kind-worker2) were silently dropped, causing connect/ETIMEDOUT errors. This made the frontend /api/recommendations endpoint fail with 500/504 after 15s, and the recommendation service returned no responses. Root cause: misconfigured Service internalTrafficPolicy=Local on the recommendation Service. Fix: patched the recommendation Service internalTrafficPolicy back to Cluster.
